referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory refers to the production of 1 kg potatoes, at farm with a moisture content of 78 %. Fresh matter yield at 78% moisture: 41001 kg/ha.; UUID: d8ce066d-8d42-3875-be68-99445d4b3fb6
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventory includes the processes of soil cultivation, sowing, weed control, fertilisation, pest and pathogen control, irrigation and harvest. Machine infrastructure and a shed for machine sheltering is included. Inputs of fertilisers, pesticides and seed as well as their transports to the farm are considered. The direct emissions on the field are also included. The system boundary is at the farm gate.
referenceFunction.name: Potatoes, at farm

technology.text: Conventional production typical for the country. Water for irrigation is pumped from 48 meter depth by electric pumps.

timePeriod.text: The yield data have been collected for the years 2001-2006.

representativeness.productionVolume: U.S. average prod of potato 20'066'292t in 2001-2006.
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Data come from the NREL database and from varoius U.S database. Data were compiled from statistics, literature, farm survey reports, documents from extension services, and expert knowledge.
